title: Write the alert contract for NERV
goal: NERV and any other consumer can read Grover's alert format, key grammar and level meaning from DESIGN.md, and a test pins them
acceptance: docs/DESIGN.md "NERV" (or "Alerts") gains the alert shape (`key`, `roomId`, `potId`, `level` `warn|bad`, `message`, `since`), the key grammar (`probe:<id>:below`, `probe:<id>:above`, `feed:<pot>`, `agent:<id>`; stable while the condition lasts, so `(key, since)` names an episode), and what each level means (`warn` when a feed is refused or a probe leaves its range, `bad` when a feed stopped partway or an agent is offline), as the hub raises them today
A hub or contracts test pins the key shapes and levels the hub emits for each condition, so a change to them fails a test
A change to the key grammar or the level meaning names nerv:F-122 in its PR (NERV classifies by them: nerv decision grover-alert-delivery)
privacy: Neutral, invented test data only; no Tailscale names, IPs, agent tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Implemented 2026-11-26: alert contract in docs/DESIGN.md and apps/hub/test/alert-contract.test.ts, which pins the behaviour as it is (no runtime change, so no test failed first). Not a measurement.
